transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um... well... I guess I'm here because... my eating has been kind of messed up lately. I just... some weeks I don't really want to eat dinner at all. And then... other times, I'm just standing in the kitchen late at night, eating crackers and sweets when everyone else is asleep. It's just... all over the place.
When you’re eating late at night like that, does it feel hard to stop or control how much you eat?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I eat a few things and then I go back to bed. It's not like I can't stop or anything. I'm just... I don't know, just having a snack, I guess.
Have you lost a lot of weight recently?

Um... no, not really. I don't think I've lost much weight. Like I said, it's just... my eating is just all over the place. Some weeks I don't eat dinner, and then... the snacking. It's just why I came in, I guess.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Um... I guess sometimes. There are just... stretches where the house feels kind of gray. And heavy. I don't really know why. I'll just sit at the kitchen table and... feel empty, I guess. Even if nothing bad actually happened that day. So... yeah.
Have you been getting less enjoyment from things you usually like to do?

Um... yeah, I suppose. It's just... things I used to look forward to, they kind of feel like chores now. Like my book club, or... cooking. Even going to galleries or tending the rose beds. I just... I keep putting them off, I guess.
Have you been sleeping more or less than usual lately?

Um... less, I guess. I don't really need as much right now. Sometimes I just... get three or four hours, and I wake up feeling fine. Like, fully charged. I end up writing for my blog or... planning things out before the sun's even up. So, yeah. Less sleep.
During those times when you only sleep three or four hours and still feel fully charged, do you also feel unusually happy or energized?

Um... I guess so. Sometimes I just feel really... bright. Like I can do anything. But then... I don't know, it shifts. I'll get really angry over something stupid. Like if my husband moves my paints, or... asks about a receipt. It just... makes me furious all of a sudden. So, yeah. I guess I do.
When you feel bright and only need a few hours of sleep, do you find yourself taking on a lot more projects or activities than usual?

I suppose I do. When I get like that... I just start a lot of things. Like, I'll sign up for committees, or... send out all these messages about workshops. I might start a few different drafts for the blog, and then... I don't know, decide to completely plan out the garden. Just... all in one day. So, yes, I guess I take on a lot.
When you feel especially bright and energized, do you feel more confident or capable than usual?

Um... I suppose so. I just... get really certain about things. Like, I'll start thinking this art-therapy workshop I want to run is... well, that it's going to change people's lives in a major way. Even though... I haven't actually finished the training for it yet. But I just feel... sure. So, yes.
During those bright, energized times, do you find yourself talking more than usual?
Um... no, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that. I don't... I don't think I talk more.
During those bright, energized times, do you spend more money than usual?
I... I don't really think about it. I mean, I buy things I need, but... I wouldn't say it's more than usual. Just normal things.
During those bright, energized times, have you ever had experiences that others said were not real, like hearing voices or becoming convinced of something despite clear evidence it wasn’t true?

Um... well... I guess... sometimes. When I get in those... those stretches where I'm planning the workshops and I don't really need to sleep... I... I don't know. Sometimes things online, like comments, they feel... different. Like they're... meant for me. Warnings, maybe. And... occasionally I think I hear someone say my name. But... nobody's there. So... maybe.
When those bright, energized periods happen, do they ever last for a full week or longer?
I... I don't really track the days. It's hard to say. Um... I don't think it's a whole week, no. Just... a few days, maybe. I'm not really sure.
Do those experiences—like comments feeling meant for you or hearing your name—happen only when you’re in those bright, energized periods?

Um... no. Not always. There have been... I guess there have been times, maybe for a few weeks at a stretch, where I didn't feel particularly energized or... or low. Just normal, I guess. But... I still felt sure people were tracking my garden photos online. And... I'd still hear those little remarks sometimes, when I was by myself. So... no. Not just then.
Have you ever heard those remarks or felt people were tracking you during one of the gray, heavy periods when you felt depressed?

Um... I don't really know. I guess... maybe? I try not to think about those heavy times too much. I just... I can't really remember if the tracking or the voices happen then. It's... it's all just kind of a blur when I get like that. So... I'm not sure.
Have there been at least two weeks when you were not feeling especially high or depressed, but you were still hearing remarks or felt people were tracking you?

Um... yeah, I think I just mentioned that. There have been... several weeks at a time where my mood was fine. I wasn't high or low. But... I still knew they were tracking the garden photos. And I still heard those remarks when I was alone. So... yes.
